description.p: OpenHamShack Radio is a native desktop transceiver for the amateur bands, 160 m to 6 cm. One process owns a software-defined radio and the whole user interface: a bandscope and waterfall with the band plan drawn on it, band stacks, SSB, CW, AM, FM with CTCSS and repeater shifts, and FT8, FT4, PSK, RTTY, FreeDV and SSTV.

It holds every transmission inside the UK licence class the operator sets, at no more than that class's power there, and warns when a transmission leaves what the RSGB band plan intends. It drives the ADALM-Pluto family on VHF and up and the Hermes-Lite 2 on HF; a simulated set of bands lets it run, and be explored, with no radio.
